title: Generalization Guarantees of Randomized Block Coordinate Descent for Nonconvex Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.22213v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Randomized block coordinate descent (RBCD) is a popular optimization algorithm for many large-scale machine learning problems. The existing theoretical analysis of RBCD mainly focuses on its convergence behavior from an optimization perspective, while its generalization behavior remains less understood for nonconvex problems. In this paper, we establish high-probability generalization guarantees for RBCD with nonconvex objectives. In the general nonconvex setting, we derive bounds on the gradients of both empirical and population risks, requiring only standard smoothness assumptions. With polynomially decaying step sizes, we tune the iteration number to balance optimization and generalization, thereby quantifying how early stopping leads to the optimal convergence rate for the population gradients. In the gradient-dominated setting, we provide bounds in terms of functional suboptimality, which nearly match the optimistic rates in convex

translated_title: 非凸学习中随机块坐标下降的泛化保证
translated_abstract: 随机块坐标下降是众多大规模机器学习问题中广泛使用的一种优化算法。现有的RBCD理论分析主要从优化角度关注其收敛行为，而其在非凸问题中的泛化行为仍然知之甚少。本文为具有非凸目标的RBCD建立了高概率泛化保证。在一般的非凸设置下，我们推导了经验风险和总体风险梯度的界，且仅需标准的光滑性假设。在采用多项式衰减步长的情况下，我们通过调整迭代次数来平衡优化与泛化，从而量化了早停如何实现总体风险梯度的最优收敛速率。在梯度主导的设置下，我们给出了关于函数次优性的界，该界几乎匹配凸优化中乐观的收敛速率。
tldr: 本文为非凸学习中的随机块坐标下降算法建立了高概率泛化保证，并通过早停策略量化了优化与泛化的平衡，实现了总体风险梯度的最优收敛速率。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes high-probability generalization guarantees for randomized block coordinate descent in nonconvex learning, and quantifies the balance between optimization and generalization through early stopping to achieve optimal convergence rates for population risk gradients.
